status_summary: On 2025-09-23 EPA published a proposed rule (docket EPA-HQ-OPPT-2025-0260) to amend the 40 CFR Part 702 procedures for TSCA risk evaluations. The proposal would restore a separate risk determination for each condition of use, delete the 2024 statement that EPA will not exclude conditions of use, remove the requirement to assess exposure pathways regulated under other statutes, and replace the 2024 limit on crediting protective equipment with consideration of reasonably available information on occupational exposure controls, including engineering and administrative controls and protective equipment (Federal Register pages 45696 to 45699 and the Unit III.C.1 text). Comments closed 2025-11-07. A Federal Register API search on 2026-10-18 found no final rule.

timeline.event: EPA published a proposed rule revising the 2024 procedures for chemical risk evaluation under TSCA (40 CFR Part 702); comments due 2025-11-07.
